items.finding: The user brief calls h33-h33-2-b2 a 0.2778 highest result, but the inspected GEMSDOE32 evidence describes its artifact as UNSCORED and labels 0.2747 as a projection.
items.resolution: No 0.2778 value is used as a measured score. It is treated as user/owner-reported and the difference is flagged for portal-receipt review.

items.finding: The submission portal error says predicted values must be in [0,1]. NaN-outside or sentinel-valued files can fail that gate even when the footprint values look valid.
items.resolution: The shipped H85 artifact is a single-band float32 zeros-outside file. The validator rereads every cell, checks finite values and [0,1], and checks CRS/shape/transform.

items.finding: The official data tab requires DrivenData access, which is not available to this agent. The feature stack is an owner-supplied GitHub bridge, not organizer-authenticated bytes.
items.resolution: Every data receipt records hashes and provenance. A future unrestricted runner can replace the mirror after checking the same geometry and hash gates.

items.finding: A catalogue holdout uses known faults as truth and therefore cannot establish organizer-private new-fault performance.
items.resolution: All results are labelled HOLDOUT-DTI, not organizer scores. A separate live selector and submission receipt are required.

items.finding: Registry uniqueness is limited to aligned rasters made available to the audit command; private organizer files are not observable.
items.resolution: The audit records roots, hashes, count, rank correlation, and three-pixel overlap and refuses promotion when thresholds are crossed.
